title: Final Closure
goal: Reconcile merged phase history into runtime evidence, validate committed taskpack truth, and run final closure gates without adding new product scope.

implementationWorkers.title: Validate committed taskpacks and closure reconciliation before running final gates

repairWorker.title: Diagnose closeout blockers without widening phase scope

successCriteria: Merged phases 0-5 can be reconciled from GitHub and git truth into runtime state and evidence without manual status edits.
Committed taskpacks parse cleanly and match the actual additive boundaries of the shipped phases.
Final release, closeout, and closure-local gates pass without adding new product surfaces.

forbiddenBoundaries.description: Phase 6 must not introduce new product surfaces; it is closure-only.

notes: Phase 6 is closure-only: it may reconcile and validate history, but it may not expand product scope.
Final closeout must be based on merged PR truth rather than manual state edits.
